summary: Mini-iteration 88 verification: (1) /app/mobile/app.json fully Aaroviah-aligned (name=Aaroviah, slug=aaroviah-mobile, scheme=aaroviah, android.package & ios.bundleIdentifier=com.centraders.aaroviah, extra.eas.projectId=b2b-handoff) — no 'addrika' identifiers (only apiBaseUrl host addrika-fragrances-backend.onrender.com, which is the intentional Render backend host). (2) eas.json has exactly development/preview/production profiles, each with the 4 EXPO_PUBLIC_* env passthroughs. (3) EAS_BUILD_GUIDE.md contains the troubleshooting callout with the exact substring "slug 'aaroviah-mobile' does not match 'addrika-mobile'" plus Fix A (rename the Expo project) and Fix B (start fresh on Expo / eas init). (4) cart.tsx still has Pressable testID='cart-share-whatsapp-btn' wired to shareCartOnWhatsApp from '../lib/web'; lib/web.ts exports shareCartOnWhatsApp(lines, brandName, subtotal) and buildShareableCartUrl building `${WEB_URL}/cart?cart=...&from=mobile-share` with wa.me fallback. (5) mobile typecheck (tsc --noEmit) exit 0. (6) yarn brand-audit exit 0 (0 hardcoded Addrika refs, 143 files). (7) GET /api/app/config -> schema_version='2' with retailer_tier_perks keys novice/bronze/silver/gold; /api/app/manifest also includes all four. (8) Browser regression on preview /cart?cart=...&from=mobile-share with cleared localStorage: both Kesar Chandan 50g x2 and Regal Rose 200g x1 render (subtotal Rs. 622, badge=3), URL cleaned to /cart (cart/from params stripped), cart persisted in localStorage addrika_cart and survives reload.

rca_of_the_issue: EAS slug mismatch is server-side: Expo project f152117c... was registered under old slug addrika-mobile while local app.json uses aaroviah-mobile. Local config is correct; resolution requires renaming the slug on expo.dev or re-running eas init after clearing projectId — both paths now documented in mobile/EAS_BUILD_GUIDE.md.
